92cc6ea061ab.title: Full-Stack Engineering Internship - Summer 2027
92cc6ea061ab.description_html:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.

The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.

Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.

For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.

Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.

  • Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
  • Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.
  • Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.
  • We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Software Engineering team builds and improves the software that makes up Immuta’s product. The team works across the front end and back end to turn product ideas and customer needs into experiences and services that help organizations use data safely and effectively.

As a Full-Stack Engineering Intern, you’ll work alongside software engineers and collaborate with teammates across product development. You’ll have the opportunity to understand how a product works across the stack, from the user experience and application layer to the services and systems behind it.

YOUR INTERNSHIP

At Immuta, interns are treated like members of the team. You’ll join the team’s regular workflow, contribute to real work, and take on responsibilities that reflect your skills and the team’s priorities.

The exact projects will depend on what the team is working on next summer, but you can expect to:

Join the Full-Stack Engineering team as an engineer, rather than working on a separate intern-only project. Build, test, improve, and maintain software that supports Immuta’s product. Work across parts of the product stack, including user-facing experiences, application services, APIs, and backend systems. Collaborate with teammates to understand problems, explore solutions, and build things that are useful to customers. Develop your skills through the team’s normal engineering workflow, including coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and collaboration. Explore how AI and agent-based capabilities can be used to build better software and product experiences. Take ownership of well-scoped work, communicate your progress, and ask questions when you need context or support.

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

Depending on your role, you may work with:

JavaScript or TypeScript Web application frameworks and user-facing product experiences Node.js or other backend services APIs and data-driven application workflows Testing, debugging, version control, and code review workflows AI-enabled tools and workflows used by your team You do not need to know every tool listed above. We’re looking for a strong foundation, curiosity, and the ability to learn.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

A foundation in software engineering and experience with at least one programming language. A clear interest in building things and solving practical problems. Curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn new technologies. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Experience beyond coursework, such as an internship, hackathon, side project, or other extracurricular experience, is a plus. Interest in JavaScript, AI, or building agent-based applications is a plus. At Immuta, our goal is to help bridge the gap between personal and professional growth, so that our team members can be well and thrive personally and professionally. After all, great professional success stories rarely happen without great personal success stories! Our generous benefits package given to all full time employees includes:
  • 100% employer paid Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision) premiums for you and your dependents (including Domestic Partners)
  • Stock Options
  • Paid parental leave (Both Maternity and Paternity)
  • Unlimited Paid time off (U.S. based positions)
  • Learning and Development Resources
  EEO NOTICE: Immuta provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, age, disability (including disability due to pregnancy) or genetics, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Immuta complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.   NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY RECRUITERS: Immuta does not accept candidates from third party recruiters. All candidates submitted through are considered to be submissions by the candidate and no submission will obligate Immuta to pay any third party for the referral or hiring of a candidate.   AI NOTICE: As part of our hiring process, Immuta may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support recruiting activities, such as application review and interview coordination. These tools assist our recruiting team but do not replace human decision-making. To protect the privacy of all participants and the confidentiality of Immuta information discussed during interviews, candidates may not use external recording tools, AI meeting assistants, or third-party transcription platforms during interviews unless approved in advance by Immuta. If you require an accessibility accommodation or assistance during the interview process, please contact us in advance so we can support your needs appropriately. For more information on how we process your personal data, please visit our Privacy Notice for Job Applicants.

92d5dbde4da6.title: Software Engineer Intern - St. Pete Site
92d5dbde4da6.title_raw: Software Engineer Intern - St. Pete Site
92d5dbde4da6.description_html:
Acron Aviation is seeking motivated and innovative Software Engineering interns to join our engineering teams in St. Petersburg, Florida.
This full-time, onsite internship is anticipated to run May through August and provides an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a professional engineering environment. You will work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to the development, testing, integration, and support of software for aviation products and technologies.
Depending on the assigned location, team, and product line, you may gain experience throughout the software development lifecycle, including software requirements, design, coding, debugging, verification, integration testing, problem investigation, technical documentation, and process improvement. The source requisition identifies these activities as central to the internship experience.  Acron Aviation is seeking motivated and innovative Software Engineering interns to join our engineering teams in St. Petersburg, Florida.
This full-time, onsite internship is anticipated to run May through August and provides an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a professional engineering environment. You will work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to the development, testing, integration, and support of software for aviation products and technologies.
Depending on the assigned location, team, and product line, you may gain experience throughout the software development lifecycle, including software requirements, design, coding, debugging, verification, integration testing, problem investigation, technical documentation, and process improvement. The source requisition identifies these activities as central to the internship experience. 

What You Will Do

Responsibilities may vary based on your assigned location, team, product line, academic background, and current business needs. Examples include: Work under the guidance of experienced software engineers and technical team members. Assist with interpreting, developing, and implementing software requirements. Support software design, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation. Develop or update software requirements-based test cases and verification procedures. Participate in software unit, integration, and system-level testing. Support pre-integration and post-integration testing activities. Assist with software verification and branch coverage analysis. Investigate, analyze, and help resolve internal and external software problem reports. Document test results, technical findings, recommendations, and corrective actions. Support the development and maintenance of internal software tools. Use configuration management and change management tools in accordance with established engineering practices. Collaborate with Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Test, Manufacturing, Quality, and other Software Engineering teams. Participate in technical reviews and software process improvement activities. Contribute to the development and support of embedded software, application software, test software, or engineering tools. Perform other software engineering assignments aligned with your academic background and the needs of the assigned team.

Required Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an accredited bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. Expected to have completed at least two years of undergraduate study before the internship begins. Foundational knowledge of software development concepts, programming, and problem-solving. Academic, project, or practical programming experience in at least one programming language. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Effective verbal communication, technical writing, and presentation skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a team-based engineering environment. Ability to learn new programming languages, development tools, technologies, and engineering processes. Ability to work full-time and onsite at the assigned Acron Aviation location for the duration of the internship This position may require access to information, technology, software, or hardware that is subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations. To comply with these requirements, applicants must qualify as a US Person.

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, project experience, prior internship experience, or knowledge in one or more of the following areas: C, C++, C#, Python, SQL, or other relevant programming languages Object-oriented programming and software design principles Embedded software or real-time systems Software requirements and requirements-based testing Software verification, debugging, and integration testing Unit testing, code coverage, or automated testing Configuration management, change management, or version-control tools Linux, QNX, VxWorks, Integrity, Windows, or other operating environments Qt or other user-interface development frameworks Processor-based or hardware-integrated software development Technical documentation and software design artifacts Aerospace, aviation, or another regulated industry Agile or other software development methodologies Technical clubs, programming competitions, research, or relevant academic projects Equal Opportunity StatementAcron Aviation is proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity and to maintaining a workplace free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Additional Information:Acron Aviation maintains a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where allowed by law.
